title_zh: 《影之刃零》首日 Steam 在线峰值超 66 万，登上全球热销榜首
content_zh:
灵游坊开发的暗黑武侠动作游戏《影之刃零》于 10 月 29 日正式发售。SteamDB 在当晚可见的记录显示，其 Steam 同时在线峰值已达到 661931 人，并位列全球热销榜第一。

Steam 商店显示，游戏由 S-GAME 自主研发和发行，采用虚幻 5 引擎。玩家扮演心脏受创、仅剩 66 天生命的剑客，在武林追杀中寻找真相；战斗包含三十余种主武器和二十多门奇诡武装，结合传统武侠、机械义肢和工业遗迹的「功夫朋克」风格。

截至 10 月 29 日晚，Steam 商店简体中文评测为「多半好评」，页面显示 5166 条简中评价；商店展示的 Metacritic 媒体均分为 88 分。国区标准版售价 268 元，数字豪华版 328 元。

🔗 相关阅读：《影之刃零》：第一个登上世界舞台的「中国武侠游戏」
title_en: Phantom Blade Zero Tops Steam Global Bestsellers with Over 660,000 Peak Players on Launch Day
content_en:
Developed and published by S-GAME, the dark wuxia action game *Phantom Blade Zero* officially launched on October 29. According to SteamDB data, the title reached a peak concurrent player count of 661,931 on its launch night, quickly claiming the top spot on Steam's global bestsellers list.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, *Phantom Blade Zero* features a distinct "kung fu punk" aesthetic that blends traditional martial arts with mechanical prosthetics and industrial ruins. Players assume the role of an injured swordsman with only 66 days left to live, embarking on a quest for truth while fending off relentless assassins using over 30 main weapons and 20 unique armaments.

As of launch night, the game holds a "Mostly Positive" rating on Steam with over 5,100 Simplified Chinese reviews and boasts an average Metacritic score of 88. In mainland China, the standard edition is priced at 268 RMB, while the Digital Deluxe edition costs 328 RMB.

title_zh: 苹果高管回应 iPad mini 仍是 60Hz
content_zh:
据 9to5Mac 报道，苹果硬件工程副总裁戴夫 · 帕库拉（Dave Pakula）日前接受了 YouTube 频道 Christopher Lawley 和 Katarina Mogus 的采访，谈到了新款 iPad mini 的屏幕、声学设计和产品定位。

针对外界关注的 60Hz 刷新率问题，帕库拉表示，显示体验不取决于单一参数。OLED 的像素响应时间比 LCD 快一个数量级以上，能让画面更流畅，并显著减少动态模糊。再加上对比度、亮度和色彩表现，他认为这是一块出色的显示屏。

在谈到 iPad mini 与 iPhone Duo 并存时的定位，帕库拉称，iPad mini 是「掌中的完整 iPad 体验」，可使用 App Store 中超过百万款应用，支持 Apple Pencil Pro，并搭载 iPadOS 27 的多任务功能。

🔗 相关阅读：iPad mini 首发上手：体验无可替代，刀法无人能及
title_en: Apple Executive Defends 60Hz Screen Choice for the New iPad mini
content_en:
In a recent interview with YouTube creators Christopher Lawley and Katarina Mogus, Dave Pakula, Apple's Vice President of Hardware Engineering, addressed public discussions regarding the new iPad mini's display, acoustic design, and market positioning.

Responding to concerns over the 60Hz refresh rate, Pakula emphasized that the visual experience cannot be defined by a single specification. He explained that OLED technology offers pixel response times more than ten times faster than traditional LCDs, enabling smoother motion and significantly reduced blur. Combined with superior contrast, brightness, and color reproduction, Pakula maintained that the device delivers an exceptional display performance.

Addressing the iPad mini's role in Apple's lineup, Pakula described it as delivering a "complete iPad experience in the palm of your hand." He highlighted its capability to access over a million apps on the App Store, full support for Apple Pencil Pro, and robust multitasking powered by iPadOS.

title_zh: 王传福披露比亚迪员工突破 102 万，研发工程师达 12 万
content_zh:
比亚迪董事长兼总裁王传福在 10 月 28 日举行的第三十三届中国汽车工程学会年会上透露，比亚迪员工总数已突破 102 万人，其中国内 96 万人、海外 6 万人，研发工程师达到 12 万名，覆盖电池、电机、电控和半导体等领域。

王传福在会上获得 2026 年度中国汽车工程学会科学技术奖汽车工业饶斌奖。他在获奖感言中回顾，比亚迪从 1994 年创业、2003 年进入汽车工业，一直采取高度垂直整合模式，持续掌握新能源汽车核心技术。

据新京报报道，现场颁奖词提到，比亚迪五年间销量从约 40 万辆增至 460 万辆，产品进入 120 多个国家和地区。王传福表示，希望通过比亚迪的发展「证明中国新能源可以，中国汽车可以」。
title_en: BYD Global Workforce Exceeds 1 Million, Supported by 120,000 R&D Engineers
content_en:
Speaking at the 33rd SAE-China Annual Meeting on October 28, BYD Chairman and President Wang Chuanfu announced that the company's global workforce has surpassed 1.02 million employees. The total includes 960,000 domestic staff and 60,000 overseas workers, backed by a massive team of 120,000 R&D engineers spanning power batteries, motors, electronic controls, and semiconductors.

Wang was honored at the event with the 2026 Rao Bin Award, China's top automotive industry technology accolade. In his acceptance speech, he reflected on BYD's trajectory since its founding in 1994 and entry into the auto market in 2003, attributing its success to a vertically integrated business model and a sustained focus on mastering core new-energy vehicle technologies.

Official event citations highlighted BYD's rapid expansion, with annual vehicle sales growing from approximately 400,000 to 4.6 million units over the past five years, reaching customers across more than 120 countries and regions. Wang stated that BYD's growth aims to prove the strength and capability of China's automotive and new-energy industries on the global stage.

title_zh: Omdia：三季度全球手机出货量降 20%，苹果持平、小米降 29%
content_zh:
Omdia 最新公布的完整三季度数据称，2026 年第三季度全球智能手机出货量为 2.547 亿部，同比下降 20%，创 2013 年以来第三季度新低。机构认为，持续涨价抑制换机需求，渠道也因设备成本和资金占用上升而谨慎备货。

三星以 5780 万部保持第一，同比下降 5%；苹果出货量为 5650 万部，与去年同期持平。Omdia 指出，iPhone 17 持续销售，以及渠道在预期涨价前提前备货，支撑了苹果在中国和北美市场的需求。

小米出货量为 3070 万部，同比下降 29%；OPPO（含 realme 和一加）为 2340 万部，下降 39%；vivo 为 1930 万部，下降 33%。非洲市场降幅达到 39%，亚太地区（不含大中华区）、中东和拉丁美洲的降幅也均超过 20%。

Omdia 预计，2026 年全球智能手机出货量将下降 12%，2027 年仍将下滑，但降幅收窄。存储供应受限、价格上涨及有限的促销空间，将继续影响厂商和渠道的库存决策。
title_en: Global Smartphone Shipments Drop 20% in Q3, Omdia Reports: Apple Holds Steady While Chinese Brands Plunge
content_en:
Global smartphone shipments fell 20% year-over-year to 254.7 million units in the third quarter of 2026, marking the lowest Q3 volume since 2013, according to research firm Omdia. The sharp decline is largely attributed to persistent price increases deterring consumer upgrades and causing retail channels to manage inventory cautiously due to high capital costs.

Samsung maintained its market leadership with 57.8 million shipments despite a 5% decline. Apple followed closely in second place with 56.5 million units, holding flat compared to the previous year. Apple's stability in North America and China was buoyed by sustained demand for the iPhone 17 and channel partners building up inventory ahead of anticipated price hikes.

In contrast, major Chinese manufacturers suffered steep losses: Xiaomi saw shipments drop 29% to 30.7 million units, while OPPO and vivo fell 39% and 33%, respectively. Geographically, shipments in Africa plummeted by 39%, while Latin America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific (excluding Greater China) all registered declines exceeding 20%.

Omdia forecasts a 12% decline in global smartphone shipments for the full year 2026, with a smaller contraction expected in 2027. Memory supply constraints, elevated component costs, and limited room for promotional pricing are expected to remain key hurdles for vendor inventory strategies.

title_zh: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT Pro 全系额度翻倍
content_zh:
刚刚，OpenAI 产品负责人 Tibo 宣布，即日起将 ChatGPT Pro 100、Pro 200、Pro 500 三个层级以及 Business Premium 的使用限额翻倍，现有订阅无需申请，自动生效。

Tibo 同时表示，OpenAI 不会降低 Pro 200 的使用限额，用户的 Work 和 Codex 使用量保持不变，dots 的扩展限额也将继续提供，dot 使用量仍与默认使用量分开计算。

官方帮助文档显示，Pro 100 和 Pro 500 的 Work 和 Codex 额度提高至此前两倍，在 ChatGPT 聊天界面使用 GPT-6 Pro 的每周消息上限不变。

Pro 200 此前额度较低的用户获得翻倍，原本额度较高的用户保持不变，最终统一至同一水平。9 月 29 日邮件通知的 Pro 200 额度削减计划已正式取消。

ChatGPT Plus 的使用额度保持不变，部分 Plus 用户在 Tibo 的评论区表达不满。

title_en: OpenAI Doubles Usage Limits Across ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium Tiers
content_en:
OpenAI has officially doubled the usage limits across its ChatGPT Pro tiers (Pro 100, Pro 200, and Pro 500) as well as its Business Premium plan. The increase takes effect automatically for all current subscribers without requiring manual requests.

According to updated documentation, Work and Codex allocations for Pro 100 and Pro 500 users have doubled, though weekly message limits for GPT-6 Pro in standard chat remain unchanged. Additionally, OpenAI fully canceled a previously planned quota reduction for Pro 200 users, standardizing all Pro 200 accounts at the higher tier allocation.

Usage quotas for ChatGPT Plus subscribers remain unchanged, prompting dissatisfaction from some Plus users across community channels.

title_zh: 美国计算机专业入学人数再降，本科两年减少 18.4%
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，美国国家学生信息交换中心 10 月 29 日发布的秋季初步数据表明，美国高校计算机与信息科学专业本科入学人数同比下降超过 12%，研究生入学人数下降超过 10%。这延续了去年开始的下滑，计算机专业此前多年的增长趋势已发生逆转。

以两年累计变化计算，相关专业本科生人数减少 18.4%，研究生减少 27.1%。该机构研究负责人 Matthew Holsapple 表示，这对于一个不久前仍是高等教育增长最快领域之一的专业而言，是显著的降幅。

同期，美国高校整体本科入学人数增长 0.6%，研究生人数下降 1.6%。报道将计算机专业面临的就业压力与企业减少初级编程岗位、AI 能力上升联系起来。

这份初步统计尚未纳入国际学生入学情况，完整报告预计于 2027 年 1 月公布。
title_en: US Computer Science Enrollment Drops Further, Down 18.4% Over Two Years
content_en:
Undergraduate enrollment in Computer and Information Sciences programs at U.S. colleges dropped more than 12% year-over-year this fall, while graduate enrollment fell over 10%, according to preliminary data from the National Student Clearinghouse. The drop extends a downturn that began last year, reversing a decade-long growth trend in tech education.

Over a cumulative two-year period, undergraduate CS enrollment has dropped by 18.4%, while graduate enrollment has plummeted by 27.1%. The sharp contraction stands out against a broader 0.6% gain in overall U.S. undergraduate enrollment during the same period.

The decline reflects growing headwinds in the tech job market, driven by corporate reductions in entry-level programming positions and the rapid rise of AI automation tools. The preliminary figures currently exclude international students, with a comprehensive report scheduled for release in January 2027.

title_zh: 上半年中国 MaaS 市场达 106.3 亿元，火山引擎以 45.1% 的份额位居第一
content_zh:
火山引擎 10 月 29 日援引 IDC《中国 AI 软件市场半年度追踪，26H1》报告称，2026 年上半年中国 MaaS（模型即服务）市场规模达到 106.3 亿元人民币，火山引擎以 45.1% 的份额位居第一。文中列明，统计针对云厂商向外部客户提供的大模型公有云服务，不包含豆包、即梦等自有业务调用。

MaaS 在中国公有云 PaaS 市场中的占比已升至 21.0%。按收入构成，大语言模型占 MaaS 市场的 47.0%，视频生成模型贡献 32.7%，其他模态模型占 20.2%。

除模型调用外，火山引擎还在拓展智能体托管服务。公司称，Managed Agents 上线两个月已产生近 500 万个任务会话，数千家企业将其用于数字员工、营销等任务；这项服务通过统一的 Agent API 提供智能体运行能力，企业无需自行搭建相应基础设施。
title_en: Volcengine Dominates China's MaaS Market with 45.1% Share in First Half
content_en:
China's Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) market reached 10.63 billion yuan in the first half of the year, with ByteDance's Volcengine securing the top spot with a dominant 45.1% market share, according to an IDC report released on October 29. The data focuses exclusively on public cloud AI services provided to external enterprise clients, excluding internal API calls from ByteDance's own applications like Doubao and Jimeng.

MaaS now accounts for 21.0% of China's public cloud PaaS market. In terms of revenue structure, Large Language Models (LLMs) generated 47.0% of total MaaS revenue, video generation models contributed 32.7%, and other multimodal models made up the remaining 20.2%.

Beyond model APIs, Volcengine is actively expanding its agent hosting capabilities. Its "Managed Agents" platform processed nearly 5 million task sessions within two months of launch, enabling thousands of enterprises to deploy digital employees and automate marketing tasks via a unified API without building custom infrastructure.

title_zh: 豆包工作向企业开放第三方模型，可统一调用 Kimi、GLM 与 DeepSeek
content_zh:
豆包工作宣布向企业客户开放第三方大模型服务，首批接入 Kimi K3.1 Pro、GLM 5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 等模型，企业可在同一工作环境中选择不同厂商的模型处理任务。

本次更新面向团队订阅版和企业订阅版客户，功能上线后默认开启，无需另向模型厂商采购或额外申请，使用量从企业已有的 AI 点数中扣除。

管理员可按成员、部门、群组或全员划定可用范围，既能按厂商批量启用，也能单独配置某个模型。企业还可指定模型在豆包电脑端、豆包工作电脑端、移动端、网页端和飞书内豆包工作等场景生效，例如只在工作电脑与飞书工作台开放。
title_en: Doubao Workplace Integrates Third-Party Models Including Kimi, GLM, and DeepSeek
content_en:
Doubao Workplace has opened third-party large language model services to enterprise clients, integrating popular models such as Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The update allows businesses to select and switch between models from different vendors within a single unified workspace.

Available to Team and Enterprise subscribers, the feature is enabled by default. Enterprises can utilize these models directly using their existing AI credit quota without needing separate procurement contracts or special approval from model vendors.

Administrators gain granular access controls, allowing them to assign model availability by individual users, departments, or custom groups. Usage can also be scoped to specific environments, such as restricting access strictly to enterprise desktop clients or Feishu (Lark) workspaces.

title_zh: 韩国拟将 AI 眼镜作弊禁考期延至 3 年，考场将配专人识别
content_zh:
韩国教育部 10 月 29 日公布智能眼镜考试作弊应对方案，计划通过举报、申请调查等方式，对利用智能眼镜蓄意干扰国家考试的行为追究刑事责任，并推动将高考作弊者的禁考期从现行的次年 1 年延长至 3 年。

现行规定区分了不同情形：在考试中使用或佩戴智能眼镜，当次成绩作废，并取消次年报考资格；仅携带、持有智能眼镜，当次成绩作废；拒绝监考人员检查，则经审议决定是否作废成绩并取消次年资格。延长至 3 年的方案需要修改《高等教育法》。

从本次高考起，每个考点将指定 1 名智能眼镜识别专员，必要时联络地方教育厅和教育部应急中心复核。教育部还将评估考场无线电探测器的可用性，研究明年部署；同时扩大监考人员责任险的保障范围与索赔期限。
title_en: South Korea Proposes 3-Year Ban and Dedicated Inspectors for AI Smart Glasses Cheating
content_en:
South Korea's Ministry of Education announced measures on October 29 to crack down on high-tech cheating using smart glasses during national examinations. The government plans to pursue criminal charges against offenders and push for legislative changes to extend the exam ban for college entrance exam cheaters from one year to three years.

Under current rules, wearing or using smart glasses during an exam invalidates test scores and disqualifies the candidate for the following year, while merely possessing them results in score cancellation. Extending the ban duration to three years will require amending the Higher Education Act.

Starting with the upcoming college entrance exam, each test site will deploy a dedicated specialist trained to spot smart glasses and coordinate with emergency response centers if necessary. The ministry is also evaluating radio-frequency detector deployments for next year while broadening liability insurance coverage for exam proctors.

title_en: SAE-China Unveils Top Automotive Tech Trends for 2027, Highlighting Solid-State Battery Progress
content_en:
The China Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE-China) released its "Top 10 Automotive Technology Trends for 2027" during its annual meeting on October 28. The report highlights critical developments across several key domains, including solid-state batteries, automotive microcontrollers, chassis control, vehicle-to-grid (V2G) integration, and edge AI models.

According to Zheng Yali, Deputy Secretary-General of SAE-China and Executive Dean of the China Automotive Strategy Advisory Institute, the trends are categorized into performance and cost breakthroughs, mass production adoption, and application scaling. Notably, solid-state batteries with energy densities reaching 400Wh/kg are projected to enter pilot trial production by 2027.

Other key technology directions outlined in the report include high-safety automotive MCUs, integrated magnesium alloy die-casting, autonomous truck platooning, distributed hub-motor drives, cockpit edge AI models, and metal 3D printing.

title_zh: 小米拟出资 17 亿元入股欣旺达动力，增资后持股 5.34%
content_zh:
欣旺达披露，小米科技全资子公司瀚星创业投资拟出资 17 亿元，认购欣旺达动力新增股份，交易完成后持股 5.34%。相关增资协议已经签署，事项经董事会审议通过，尚需提交股东会审议。

本次增资及董事会换届完成后，欣旺达通过惠州新能源持有的欣旺达动力股份将由 24.06% 降至 22.78%，董事会席位不超过半数，欣旺达动力将由控股子公司转为参股公司，不再纳入欣旺达合并报表。

公告股权表显示，理想汽车也在股东之列，本次增资后的持股比例为 8.32%。小米入股前，今年 9 月已与欣旺达动力、中创新航达成动力电池战略合作。
title_en: Xiaomi to Acquire 5.34% Stake in EV Battery Maker Sunwoda EVB for 1.7 Billion Yuan
content_en:
Xiaomi Technology, through its wholly owned subsidiary Hanstar Venture Capital, plans to invest 1.7 billion yuan to subscribe to new shares in Sunwoda EVB. Upon completion of the transaction, Xiaomi will hold a 5.34% stake in the EV battery manufacturer. The investment agreement has been approved by the board and is awaiting final shareholder approval.

Following the capital increase and board restructuring, parent company Sunwoda's indirect stake will decrease from 24.06% to 22.78%. Holding no more than half of the board seats, Sunwoda EVB will transition from a consolidated subsidiary to an associate company, meaning its financials will no longer be consolidated into Sunwoda's balance sheet.

The disclosure also reveals that Li Auto remains a major shareholder with an 8.32% post-transaction stake. Prior to this equity investment, Xiaomi established strategic power battery partnerships with both Sunwoda EVB and CALB in September.

title_zh: 比亚迪三季度归母净利润增 28%，前三季度仍同比下降
content_zh:
比亚迪发布 2026 年第三季度报告，单季营业收入 2214.88 亿元，同比增长 13.59%；归母净利润 100.20 亿元，同比增长 28.08%；扣非归母净利润 86.30 亿元，同比增长 25.25%。

前三季度累计营业收入为 5663.04 亿元，同比增长 0.01%；归母净利润 223.45 亿元，同比下降 4.24%；扣非归母净利润 210.04 亿元，同比增长 2.51%。经营活动现金流净额为 544.70 亿元，同比增长 33.36%，公司解释主要与购买商品、接受劳务支付的现金减少有关。

报告同时显示，期末存货较上年末增加 60.08%，主要因海外汽车业务增长、备货增加；财务费用增加，主要因本期出现汇兑损失，而去年同期为汇兑收益。该季度财务报告未经审计。
title_en: BYD Posts 28% Q3 Net Profit Growth Despite Lower First-Nine-Month Earnings
content_en:
BYD has released its financial results for the third quarter, reporting revenue of 221.49 billion yuan, a 13.59% increase year-on-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose 28.08% year-on-year to 10.02 billion yuan, while adjusted non-recurring net profit reached 8.63 billion yuan, up 25.25%.

For the first nine months, cumulative revenue edged up 0.01% to 566.30 billion yuan. However, total net profit dropped 4.24% year-on-year to 22.35 billion yuan, even as adjusted non-recurring net profit grew 2.51%. Net operating cash flow surged 33.36% to 54.47 billion yuan, primarily driven by reduced cash payments for procurement and services.

BYD noted a 60.08% increase in inventory compared to the end of last year, attributing the surge to expanding overseas vehicle operations and strategic stock accumulation. Financial expenses also rose due to foreign exchange losses, compared to exchange gains during the same period last year. The quarterly report is unaudited.

title_zh: DoorDash 拟以 170 亿美元收购 Instacart，保留独立品牌和 App
content_zh:
据 TechCrunch 报道，DoorDash 于 10 月 29 日宣布，已同意以 170 亿美元收购生鲜配送平台 Instacart，对应每股总价值 65 美元。双方董事会均已批准交易，预计于 2027 年底或 2028 年上半年完成。

DoorDash 计划保留 Instacart 的品牌、企业技术产品和 App。交易完成前，两家公司继续独立运营。Instacart CEO Chris Rogers 表示，公司面向零售商的生鲜技术、零售及品牌合作关系，将与 DoorDash 的全球消费者网络和物流能力结合。

DoorDash 称，Instacart 的技术可帮助更多商超搭建自有线上订购平台与广告业务，商超也可使用 DoorDash 的履约服务处理线上订单。DoorDash CEO 徐迅表示，Instacart 在生鲜挑选和替代品选择方面的经验，与 DoorDash 配送网络及本地商户工具具有互补性。
title_en: DoorDash to Acquire Instacart for $17 Billion, Retaining Separate Brand and App
content_en:
DoorDash has agreed to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart in a transaction valued at $17 billion, or $65 per share, according to a report by TechCrunch. Approved by both boards of directors, the transaction is expected to close between late 2027 and the first half of 2028. Both companies will continue operating independently until the deal completes.

DoorDash plans to retain the Instacart brand, app, and enterprise technology suite. Instacart CEO Chris Rogers noted that combining the company's grocery technology and merchant relationships with DoorDash’s logistics network and global consumer base creates strong synergies.

DoorDash CEO Tony Xu emphasized that Instacart's expertise in grocery picking and substitution selection complements DoorDash’s delivery network and merchant tools. The integration is expected to help grocers build out their online ordering platforms and advertising operations while leveraging DoorDash for order fulfillment.

title_zh: 英特尔数据中心收入增 78%，预计 PC 疲软延续至明年上半年
content_zh:
英特尔公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收为 165 亿美元，同比增长 21%；GAAP 归母净利润约 33 亿美元，同比下降 18%，经调整净利润约 28 亿美元，同比增长 169%。GAAP 摊薄每股收益为 0.60 美元，经调整每股收益为 0.52 美元。

业务表现出现分化：客户端计算与物理 AI 部门收入为 81 亿美元，同比下降 5%；数据中心与 AI 部门收入达 73 亿美元，同比增长 78%。CEO 陈立武表示，当前首要任务是增加供给，以满足至强处理器的需求；CFO David Zinsner 则预计，PC 市场放缓至少持续到明年上半年。

公司当季 GAAP 毛利率为 43%，经营现金流为 51 亿美元。第四季度营收指引为 150 亿美元至 160 亿美元，GAAP 每股收益预计为 0.10 美元，经调整每股收益预计为 0.25 美元。
title_en: Intel Reports 78% Surge in Data Center Revenue, Expects PC Weakness to Persist Through H1 Next Year
content_en:
Intel reported its third-quarter financial results, posting revenue of $16.5 billion, a 21% increase year-over-year. While GAAP net income dropped 18% to $3.3 billion, adjusted net income surged 169% to $2.8 billion, yielding an adjusted earnings per share of $0.52.

Business performance highlighted a stark divide across segments. Revenue in the Data Center and AI group jumped 78% year-over-year to $7.3 billion, driven by strong demand for Xeon processors, which CEO Lip-Bu Tan identified as a top supply priority. Conversely, the Client Computing and Physical AI segment fell 5% to $8.1 billion, with CFO David Zinsner predicting that PC market weakness will persist through at least the first half of next year.

For the quarter, Intel generated $5.1 billion in operating cash flow with a GAAP gross margin of 43%. Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, the company forecasts revenue between $15 billion and $16 billion, with expected adjusted earnings per share of $0.25.

title_zh: Reddit 将测试登录后完整访问，应对 AI 抓取与搜索导流下滑
content_zh:
据 TechCrunch 报道，Reddit 在第三季度财报电话会上宣布，将逐步转向以登录用户为主的访问体验，并计划在第四季度先于美国以外的部分市场测试。

Reddit 称，10 月来自搜索引擎的导流平均每周减少超过 100 万次。第三季度全球日活用户为 1.303 亿，环比基本持平；美国日活用户从上季度的 5320 万降至 5070 万，同比下降 2%。

公司希望借登录机制保护数据、减少 AI 抓取，并获得更多用户兴趣与行为信号，用于广告及内容推荐。CEO Steve Huffman 在公开帖文中表示，这是对平台与业务的正确决定。

测试将逐步推进，全球推广时间尚未确定。Reddit 同时表示，未登录首页仍有必要，登录也可保留匿名身份，其匿名浏览模式正在重建。
title_en: Reddit to Test Logged-In Requirement to Counter AI Scraping and Search Traffic Decline
content_en:
Reddit plans to gradually transition toward a logged-in user experience to protect platform data and offset declining traffic from search engines, according to statements made during its third-quarter earnings call. The company will begin testing logged-in requirements in select international markets outside the United States during the fourth quarter.

The strategic shift comes as search engine referrals dropped by over one million per week in October. While Reddit recorded 130.3 million global daily active users (DAUs) in Q3—roughly flat quarter-over-quarter—U.S. DAUs fell 2% year-over-year to 50.7 million.

By encouraging users to log in, Reddit aims to curb unauthorized AI data scraping while capturing richer user signals to enhance advertising and content recommendations. CEO Steve Huffman called the change the right decision for the platform's long-term business. Reddit confirmed that the logged-out homepage will remain accessible and that it is rebuilding its anonymous browsing mode to preserve user privacy.

title_zh: 智元披露上半年营收近 20 亿元，推出机器人「有效智能工时」指标
content_zh:
据科创板日报现场报道，智元在 10 月 29 日创新日大会上披露，2026 年上半年公司营收接近 20 亿元。第一财经记者的现场报道同时确认，智元第 2 万台具身智能机器人已于今年 9 月下线。

智元联合创始人、总裁兼 CTO 彭志辉还发布 Worken（有效智能工时），用「活跃机器人数量 × 自主工作时长 × 产出效能比」衡量机器人自主作业的实际产出，关注机器人持续完成任务创造的成果。

据澎湃新闻现场报道，这套指标已用于成都宽窄巷子游客服务、龙旗产线上下料、地铁安检引导、珠海长隆文娱表演、爱仕达零售导购和香格里拉酒店服务等场景。彭志辉认为，物理 AI 从可用走向通用，需要经过可用本体、细分场景部署、基座模型泛化、群体智能和智能自举等阶段。
title_en: Agibot Reports ~2B Yuan Revenue, Unveils 'Worken' Metric for Robot Productivity
content_en:
Agibot disclosed at its Innovation Day event that its revenue approached 2 billion yuan in the first half of the year, while confirming that its 20,000th embodied AI robot rolled off the production line in September.

During the conference, Co-founder, President, and CTO Peng Zhihui introduced "Worken" (Effective Intelligent Working Hours)—a metric designed to quantify the actual output of autonomous robots. Calculated as "Active Robots × Autonomous Working Hours × Output Efficiency Ratio," the standard shifts focus toward the tangible value generated by sustained robot operations.

The Worken metric is already being applied across multiple real-world scenarios, including tourist services at Chengdu's Kuanzhai Alley, assembly line handling at Longcheer, subway security guidance, and hospitality at Shangri-La Hotels. Peng noted that transitioning physical AI from usable to universal requires key stages: functional hardware, domain deployment, base model generalization, swarm intelligence, and intelligent self-bootstrapping.

title_zh: 💡 李亮谈红果短剧：核心是内容质量，专家自媒体应遵守道德规范
content_zh:
第一财经 10 月 29 日报道，按用户总使用时长计算，红果已成为国内第四大 App，仅次于抖音、微信和抖音极速版；该文援引 QuestMobile 数据称，今年 7 月红果日活跃用户达到 1.68 亿。围绕短剧发展与「字节时间」争议，抖音集团副总裁李亮同日再次发文。

李亮认为，短剧与传统影视剧的差别主要在载体和表现形式，核心仍是内容质量。他以单集时长为例：若改为 45 分钟或 90 分钟一集，短剧与电视剧、电影之间的区别便会缩小。随着更多有知识、有文化的创作者加入，他认为短剧质量正在迅速提升。

他举出红果的非遗题材短剧《鱼皮穿出新花样》：作品围绕赫哲族鱼皮制作技艺，讲述手艺人与返乡年轻人制作鱼皮画、开展直播、传承手艺的故事。李亮还看好 AI 在历史、科幻题材中降低复杂场景制作成本，并称包括腾讯绿泡泡在内的同行正在快速增长，希望各方「在阳光下竞争，共同健康发展」。

谈到与秦朔的争论，李亮表示，专家转型自媒体、收费高于普通自媒体，只要市场接受就是合理的，但应遵循基本道德规范。他反对以部分应用的使用时长数据，对整个中国互联网作出「字节时间」的定性。
title_en: Douyin VP Speaks on Short Dramas: Quality Matters Most, Creators Must Uphold Ethics
content_en:
Following reports that Hongguo Short Drama has become China's fourth-largest app by user time spent—reaching 168 million daily active users in July—Douyin Group Vice President Li Liang addressed industry developments and ongoing market debates.

Li emphasized that while short dramas differ in format from traditional film and television, high-quality content remains the ultimate key to success. With educated creators joining the space, production values are rising rapidly. He highlighted cultural projects like *New Patterns in Fish Skin* and noted that AI tools are significantly lowering costs for complex historical and sci-fi scenes.

Addressing discussions surrounding expert media monetization and market positions, Li stated that expert creators charging higher rates is acceptable if backed by market demand, provided basic ethical norms are maintained. He also rejected assertions that user time metrics alone define the broader internet ecosystem, calling for healthy and transparent industry competition.

title_zh: 18999 元起，三星 W27 发布：215g 机身支持天通卫星通信
content_zh:
三星「心系天下」W27 折叠屏手机 10 月 29 日发布，官网已开放预订。16GB + 512GB 版本售价 18999 元，16GB + 1TB 版本售价 21999 元，提供「霁湖蓝」和「霁霞红」两种配色。

新机采用金色边框与铰链装饰，背板使用康宁大猩猩玻璃陶瓷 3，屏幕底部加入双层钛缓震结构。机身重量约 215g，展开厚约 4.1mm、折叠厚约 8.9mm，厚度不含摄像头模组。主要配置包括：

W27 搭载 One UI 9，支持双分屏和三分屏操作；天通卫星通信可用于通话和短信，需先开通运营商对应业务。
title_en: Samsung Unveils W27 Foldable: Ultra-Slim 215g Body with Satellite Connectivity Starting at 18,999 Yuan
content_en:
Samsung has officially launched its luxury foldable smartphone, the W27, priced at 18,999 yuan for the 16GB+512GB configuration and 21,999 yuan for the 16GB+1TB tier. The device is currently available for pre-order in two premium finishes: Ji Lake Blue and Ji Sunset Red.

The flagship device features gold-accented frames and hinges, a Corning Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3 back panel, and a dual-layer titanium cushioning structure beneath the display. Weighing approximately 215 grams, it measures an ultra-slim 4.1 mm unfolded and 8.9 mm folded (excluding the camera module).

Powered by One UI 9, the W27 supports dual- and triple-screen multitasking. It also integrates Tiantong satellite connectivity, enabling voice calls and messaging via carrier satellite plans when terrestrial networks are unavailable.

title_zh: 王腾发布今日宜休睡眠产品，智能戒指 1799 元起
content_zh:
10 月 29 日，王腾创立的 ISHO 今日宜休发布 ISHO Ring 智能戒指、iFlow 智能温控系统及个人睡眠健康 AI 技术体系 ISHO Intelligence，两款硬件均已开启预售。

王腾在发布会最后向小米和雷军致谢，称自己珍惜在小米的经历，学会了如何做好产品、带好团队。

会后采访中，他还表示，公司未来可能采用智能硬件与健康数据服务两层商业模式，在数据和专业知识积累后，为部分高级分析功能提供付费订阅。
title_en: ISHO Launches AI Sleep Tech and Smart Ring Starting at 1,799 Yuan
content_en:
On October 29, ISHO, a sleep technology brand founded by Wang Teng, officially launched the ISHO Ring smart ring, the iFlow smart temperature control system, and its AI-powered sleep health ecosystem, ISHO Intelligence. Pre-orders for both hardware products are now open, with the smart ring starting at 1,799 yuan.

During the launch event, Wang expressed his gratitude toward Xiaomi and Lei Jun, stating that his previous career experience at Xiaomi taught him how to build great products and lead teams effectively.

In a post-event interview, Wang revealed that ISHO plans to adopt a dual-layer business model combining smart hardware with health data services. Once sufficient data and domain expertise are accumulated, the company intends to introduce paid subscriptions for advanced health analytics.

title_zh: 小鹏 MONA L05 上市，限时 13.98 万元起
content_zh:
小鹏 MONA L05 于 10 月 29 日晚正式上市，定位大五座 SUV，提供纯电和超级增程两种动力。发布会价格表显示，新车推出 6 款配置，指导价为 14.48 万—17.68 万元；在 2026 年 12 月 15 日 24 时前下定，可享 5000 元限时现金减免，对应价格为 13.98 万—17.18 万元。

小鹏此前公布，Ultra SE 版配备两颗图灵 AI 芯片及第二代 VLA 模型，Max 版配备一颗图灵 AI 芯片和 VLA Lite 模型。超级增程版满油满电的 CLTC 综合续航为 1310km，CLTC 纯电续航最长 310km。

🔗 相关阅读：13.98 万元起！小鹏 MONA L05 上市，大五座 SUV 市场的卷王来了
title_en: XPeng Launches MONA L05 SUV Starting at a Limited-Time Price of 139,800 Yuan
content_en:
XPeng officially launched the MONA L05 SUV on the evening of October 29. Positioned as a spacious five-seater SUV, the new vehicle offers both fully electric and super extended-range electric (EREV) powertrains across six trim levels.

The official list price for the MONA L05 ranges from 144,800 to 176,800 yuan. However, customers who place orders before midnight on December 15, 2026, can take advantage of a limited-time 5,000 yuan cash discount, bringing the starting price down to 139,800 yuan.

In terms of smart driving hardware, the Ultra SE variant features dual Turing AI chips paired with XPeng's second-generation VLA model, while the Max variant comes with a single Turing AI chip running the VLA Lite model. The super extended-range version delivers a combined CLTC range of up to 1,310 km, with a pure electric CLTC range of up to 310 km.

title_zh: 腾讯发布 Buddy One，文档、会议与知识库可跨应用检索
content_zh:
10 月 29 日，腾讯在全球数字生态大会发布跨应用 AI 协同体系 Buddy One，打通腾讯文档、腾讯会议、腾讯网盘和 ima，共享 WorkBuddy Agent 底座、账号与积分池。同期发布的腾讯网盘为这套工具提供统一存储。

面向个人用户，WorkBuddy PC 端升级至 5.9.0 及以上版本后，可在管理中心关联各应用账号。WorkBuddy 随后能检索已授权的文档、会议与知识库，整合资料并在回答中标明出处。账号关联免费，目前暂不支持解绑；跨产品记忆共享将在后续推出。

加入 Buddy One 后，WorkBuddy 积分可在已关联的腾讯文档、ima、腾讯网盘中通用，消耗后共享余额同步减少。腾讯会议目前不涉及积分消耗，其账号关联后仍可供 WorkBuddy 检索会议内容。用户此前在 ima、腾讯文档中单独获得或购买的积分仍按原规则使用，不会合并或清零。

企业端，腾讯宣布 WorkBuddy 将继续开放产品架构，支持企业自研 Agent、第三方 Agent 及第三方 IM 接入。汤道生还预告混元 Hy4 与 Hy4 flash 近期发布：Hy4 将强化长程生产力任务、提高思维链效率，并首次引入视觉理解；Hy4 flash 则继承视觉与 Agent 能力。
title_en: Tencent Unveils Buddy One for Cross-App AI Collaboration Across Documents, Meetings, and Storage
content_en:
At its Global Digital Ecosystem Conference on October 29, Tencent introduced Buddy One, a cross-application AI collaboration framework. The platform seamlessly integrates Tencent Docs, Tencent Meeting, Tencent Cloud Drive, and ima under a shared WorkBuddy Agent foundation, unifying accounts and credit pools while using Tencent Cloud Drive for centralized storage.

For individual users running WorkBuddy PC client version 5.9.0 or later, connecting accounts enables cross-app retrieval across authorized documents, meeting transcripts, and personal knowledge bases. WorkBuddy can synthesize information across these channels while citing sources. Additionally, a unified credit balance allows points to be shared and consumed across connected Tencent productivity products.

For enterprise clients, Tencent announced an open architecture supporting custom in-house agents, third-party agents, and external IM platforms. Tencent also teased the upcoming release of its Hunyuan Hy4 and Hy4 Flash models, which feature enhanced long-horizon productivity capabilities, faster chain-of-thought processing, and native visual understanding.

title_zh: 699 元，Bose 有线消噪耳塞国行上市
content_zh:
Bose 有线消噪耳塞于 10 月 29 日在国内上市，官方售价 699 元，即日起在官方渠道发售。新耳塞采用 USB-C 接口，由连接的手机、平板或电脑供电，不需要蓝牙配对、内置电池或额外充电。

耳塞搭载 QuietControl 主动消噪技术，每侧配置两枚麦克风，可在线控上切换安静、通透和关闭消噪三种模式。线控还提供音量、播放与通话实体按键，背面设有专用通话麦克风。

音频部分采用 SoundDesign 数字信号处理技术和 UAC2 协议，固定以 24-bit/48kHz 规格播放输出。耳机线长约 1.28 米，耳塞具备 IPX4 防水，随附三种尺寸的硅胶耳塞套、两种尺寸的稳固耳翼和拉链收纳盒。配色包括经典黑、晨雾白，以及限量沁凉薄荷色。
title_en: Bose Launches USB-C Wired Noise-Canceling Earbuds in China for 699 Yuan
content_en:
Bose has officially released its new USB-C Wired Noise-Canceling Earbuds in China, priced at 699 RMB. Powered directly by connected smartphones, tablets, or laptops, the earbuds eliminate the need for Bluetooth pairing, internal batteries, or charging.

Equipped with Bose's QuietControl active noise-cancellation technology, each earbud houses two microphones. Users can toggle between Quiet, Aware, and Off modes using the inline controller, which also includes tactile buttons for volume and playback alongside a dedicated microphone on the back for voice calls.

The earbuds utilize SoundDesign digital signal processing delivering fixed 24-bit/48kHz audio output. Features include a 1.28-meter cable, IPX4 water resistance, three sizes of silicone tips, two sizes of stability fins, and a carrying case. Color options include Black, White, and a limited-edition Mint.

title_zh: 尼康发布 120-300mm 长焦镜头，内置 1.4 倍增距镜
content_zh:
尼康 10 月 29 日发布尼克尔 Z 120-300mm f/2.8 TC VR S 全画幅长焦变焦镜头，面向体育摄影。它在 120-300mm 焦段保持 f/2.8 恒定最大光圈，并内置 1.4 倍增距镜，一键切换后可覆盖至 420mm，最大光圈相应变为 f/4。

镜头重约 2735g，比 2020 年推出的 F 卡口 AF-S 120-300mm f/2.8E 镜头轻约 515g。内对焦与内变焦结构让镜身长度在对焦、变焦时保持不变；Silky Swift VCM 马达负责自动对焦，配合中孔非晶态镀膜和 ARNEO 镀膜抑制鬼影与眩光。

搭配支持同步减震的机身时，镜头可在画面中心及边缘实现最高 6.5 挡防抖，并支持阿卡标准云台快装。尼康将其定位于室内冰上赛事、网球、足球等需要快速切换拍摄距离的场景。
title_en: Nikon Announces NIKKOR Z 120-300mm f/2.8 Lens with Built-In 1.4x Teleconverter
content_en:
Nikon has unveiled the NIKKOR Z 120-300mm f/2.8 TC VR S, a full-frame telephoto zoom lens engineered for sports photography. Maintaining a constant f/2.8 maximum aperture throughout its zoom range, the lens features a built-in 1.4x teleconverter that extends its focal length to 420mm at f/4 with a single switch.

Weighing roughly 2,735 grams—515 grams lighter than its F-mount predecessor—the lens employs an internal zoom and focus mechanism to maintain consistent dimensions. It features a Silky Swift VCM autofocus motor alongside Meso Amorphous and ARNEO coatings to drastically reduce ghosting and flare.

When paired with compatible camera bodies supporting Synchro VR, the lens offers up to 6.5 stops of vibration reduction. It also incorporates an Arca-Swiss compatible tripod foot, making it tailored for fast-moving events like football, tennis, and indoor ice sports.

title_zh: TRAE 宝上线，跨项目记住历史方案并调度开发任务
content_zh:
字节跳动旗下 AI 开发工具 TRAE 于 10 月 29 日上线个人助理「TRAE 宝」，把跨项目的长期记忆与单个项目的任务执行连接起来。

它采用「全局助理 + 项目助理」两层结构。全局助理可查找用户过去的任务、对话和交付产物，整理历史方案、约束与决策，为新需求准备上下文。官方以权限管理为例：用户可以要求它先找出以前做过的方案，判断哪些可复用、哪些需要调整，再交给项目助理开发。

项目助理负责围绕当前代码和项目上下文拆解需求，让能够并行的页面、接口、测试和文档任务同时推进，并按依赖组织联调、验证和结果汇总。开发者也可以继续布置其他任务，由助理集中反馈进度、待定事项和交付产物。
title_en: ByteDance Launches AI Assistant 'TRAE Bao' with Cross-Project Memory and Task Scheduling
content_en:
ByteDance has updated its AI development platform TRAE with a new personal assistant named "TRAE Bao." The feature connects long-term cross-project memory with localized task execution, allowing developers to draw on past decisions to accelerate new development.

TRAE Bao utilizes a dual-layer architecture consisting of a Global Assistant and a Project Assistant. The Global Assistant analyzes past tasks, chat histories, and code outputs to summarize reusable logic, design constraints, and technical decisions for new prompts.

Meanwhile, the Project Assistant breaks down requirements within the context of the active code repository. It coordinates concurrent workflows across UI pages, APIs, unit tests, and documentation while managing dependencies for integration testing, enabling developers to delegate complex tasks and monitor progress seamlessly.

title_zh: 英伟达开放 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe，支持 40 种语言和长录音转录
content_zh:
英伟达开放语音模型 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe，并发布多语言语音数据管线 Granary v2。模型可处理最长 1 小时的录音，支持 40 种语言，能按自然语言指令生成逐字稿、整理后的文本、翻译，以及带说话人和词级时间戳的转录结果。

这款模型采用混合专家架构，含音频编码器在内总参数约 340 亿，激活参数约 43 亿。针对多人重叠说话，它把说话人识别信息融入语音编码，支持从短片段到完整会议、通话的说话人标注。

官方模型卡已提供 BF16、FP8、NVFP4 等版本，并采用 OpenMDW-1.1 许可证开放权重和微调工具。Granary v2 则覆盖 48 种语言、16 个源语料库，为约 46.3 万小时语音生成转录、翻译和语音问答等训练材料，数据整理管线源码已公开。
title_en: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Speech Model with 40-Language Support
content_en:
NVIDIA has released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech model capable of processing audio recordings up to one hour long across 40 languages. Alongside the model, NVIDIA launched Granary v2, a multilingual speech data pipeline containing roughly 463,000 hours of training materials across 48 languages.

Built on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 34 billion total parameters and 4.3 billion active parameters, Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe can follow natural language instructions to generate verbatim transcripts, refined text, translations, and word-level timestamps with speaker diarization. It effectively handles overlapping speech by embedding speaker recognition directly into its speech encoder.

The model weights—available in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 formats—and fine-tuning tools are accessible under the OpenMDW-1.1 license, while the source code for Granary v2's data processing pipeline has also been fully open-sourced.

title_zh: 智元发布 GO-3 Preview，计划年底开源具身基座模型
content_zh:
在 10 月 29 日的智元创新日上，智元联合创始人、联席总裁、具身智能体系总裁姚卯青发布新一代具身基座模型 GO-3 Preview，并宣布计划于 2026 年底全面开源。

据财闻现场报道，GO-3 Preview 采用智元自研的 WRAM（World Reasoning Action Model）架构，将理解、预测与动作统一建模，面向跨任务泛化与精细操作。

围绕这套基座，智元把 Genie Evolver 后训练系统和 Genie Master 具身智能体框架连接起来：前者协同真机、仿真和世界模型，后者承接部署后的任务执行与反馈，组成覆盖预训练、后训练和部署后学习的链路。姚卯青表示，这套体系将推动机器人在真实作业中持续提升能力。

据 36 氪邱晓芬的现场报道，智元同场还发布通用运动智能算法框架 AGILE、原生多模态交互模型 WITA-OMNI，以及 AHA3 第三代硬件架构。WITA-OMNI 在现场展示了无需唤醒词、可被打断的对话；报道援引现场测试称，最快响应为 400 毫秒，支持 20 多种情感表达和 73 种语言。

灵渠 OS 1.0 则面向硬件、通信与智能能力的协同，支持 15 类、100 多种外设接入。智元宣布与开放原子开源基金会共建中国人形机器人开源社区，捐赠灵渠 OS 项目，并计划于 2026 年底将灵渠 OS 1.0 全面开源。
title_en: Agibot Unveils GO-3 Embodied Foundation Model, Targets Full Open-Source Release by 2026
content_en:
At its Innovation Day event on October 29, Chinese robotics company Agibot unveiled its next-generation embodied foundation model, GO-3 Preview, announcing plans to fully open-source the model by the end of 2026. Powered by Agibot's proprietary World Reasoning Action Model (WRAM) architecture, GO-3 Preview unifies understanding, prediction, and action modeling to achieve cross-task generalization and precise physical manipulation.

The new model integrates with Agibot's Genie Evolver post-training system and Genie Master agent framework. Together, these systems link real-world robotics, simulation, and world models to create a complete loop spanning pre-training, post-training, and post-deployment learning.

Alongside GO-3, Agibot introduced several key technologies, including the AGILE motion intelligence framework, the AHA3 hardware architecture, and WITA-OMNI—a native multimodal model capable of wake-word-free, interruptible conversations with response times as fast as 400 milliseconds. Agibot also launched Lingqu OS 1.0 for cross-hardware coordination and announced a partnership with the OpenAtom Foundation to build a national open-source humanoid robotics community.

title_zh: 一加 Ace 7 系列发布，9000mAh 电池配双路风冷
content_zh:
一加 10 月 29 日发布 Ace 7 和 Ace 7 Pro，两款均采用 6.78 英寸直屏、9000mAh 电池和 100W 有线快充，并加入双路冰河风冷系统。屏幕日常最高支持 165Hz 自适应刷新，185Hz 在部分游戏场景生效。

价格方面，一加 Ace 7 起售价 4399 元（12GB + 256GB）；Ace 7 Pro 起售价 4799 元。
title_en: OnePlus Launches Ace 7 Series Featuring Massive 9000mAh Battery and Dual Air-Cooling
content_en:
OnePlus officially launched the Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro on October 29. Both smartphones feature a 6.78-inch flat display, an extraordinary 9000mAh battery, and 100W wired fast charging. To manage thermal output during intensive tasks, both models are equipped with a dual-channel Glacier air-cooling system.

The display supports a 165Hz adaptive refresh rate for standard daily use, boosting up to 185Hz in supported gaming scenarios.

Pricing for the OnePlus Ace 7 starts at 4,399 RMB for the base 12GB + 256GB configuration, while the Ace 7 Pro begins at 4,799 RMB.

title_zh: Meta 推出 AI 衣橱 App，可从 Instagram 照片搭配穿衣方案
content_zh:
据 TechCrunch 报道，Meta 推出 AI 穿搭应用 Style Sketch，已在印度尼西亚、新加坡和泰国的 iOS 与 Android 平台上线。

应用可连接 Instagram，从用户发布过的照片建立虚拟衣橱，也可通过拍照、短视频或上传相册图片添加衣物。它会基于已有衣物给出搭配，用户也能先指定某件单品，再生成不同组合。

根据应用介绍，虚拟试穿模特可匹配用户的体型与肤色。出行时，用户输入目的地、行程天数和活动安排，应用还能结合天气预报，生成逐日穿搭计划。
title_en: Meta Launches Style Sketch: An AI Wardrobe App Powered by Instagram Photos
content_en:
Meta has launched *Style Sketch*, an AI-powered outfit app now available on iOS and Android across Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand.

The app connects directly to Instagram, scanning users' posted photos to build a virtual wardrobe. Users can also add clothing items by taking photos, uploading short videos, or importing images from their device gallery. *Style Sketch* generates complete outfit recommendations based on existing clothes or creates custom combinations starting from a single selected item.

To enhance realism, the virtual try-on avatars can be customized to match a user’s body shape and skin tone. Additionally, the app features a smart travel planner: users input their destination, trip duration, and scheduled activities, and *Style Sketch* generates a day-by-day outfit plan tailored to local weather forecasts.

title_zh: Mistral 开放 Large 4 权重，编码成绩追平 GLM-5.3
content_zh:
Mistral 于 10 月 29 日开放 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的改进版权重。这款万亿参数多模态模型此前于月初进入公开预览，新版重点提升智能体编码、防御性网络安全和推理效率，开发者可下载后自行部署和调整。

据 Mistral 公布的数据，新版在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 上取得 48% 的成绩，与 GLM-5.3 接近，每任务平均 Token 消耗比后者少 47%。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 中，新版得分由预览版的 28% 升至 41%，输出 Token 减少 30%。模型提供 Low、Medium 和默认的 High 三种推理模式。

在用于衡量漏洞发现、验证与修复的 Artificial Analysis Cyber Index 中，模型得分为 51%。Mistral 还向经过审查的企业设计伙伴提供专门的安全工作流变体预览，测试限于自有或明确授权的系统。

权重通过 Hugging Face 提供，采用修改自 MIT 的 Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight 许可，可使用、修改、微调和商业化；经营 Model-as-a-Service 服务的企业须另获商业许可。开发者也可通过 Mistral API、OpenRouter 及 Microsoft Foundry 使用模型。
title_en: Mistral Releases Open Weights for Mistral Large 4, Matching GLM-5.3 in Coding Benchmarks
content_en:
Mistral has released open weights for an updated version of Mistral Large 4 (codenamed "Le Chonk"). Following its public preview earlier this month, the trillion-parameter multimodal model now features major enhancements in agentic coding, defensive cybersecurity, and reasoning efficiency, allowing developers to download, self-deploy, and fine-tune it locally.

According to benchmark data published by Mistral, the updated model scored 48% on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index—putting it on par with GLM-5.3 while consuming 47% fewer tokens per task. On Terminal-Bench 4.0, its score jumped from 28% in the preview to 41%, alongside a 30% reduction in output tokens. The model also introduces three selectable reasoning modes: Low, Medium, and High.

In cybersecurity evaluations, the model achieved a 51% score on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index. A specialized security workflow variant is currently available in preview for vetted enterprise partners conducting authorized system testing.

The weights are available on Hugging Face under the modified MIT-based Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, permitting modification and commercial use, though Model-as-a-Service providers require a separate license. The model can also be accessed via the Mistral API, OpenRouter, and Microsoft Foundry.

title_zh: 《塞尔达传说》40 周年纪念版 Switch 2 发售
content_zh:
任天堂《塞尔达传说》40 周年纪念版 Switch 2 于 10 月 29 日发售，同主题 Pro 手柄和便携包也在当天推出。主机、Joy-Con 2 和底座采用系列特别设计，Pro 手柄附带展示台。

任天堂特别注明，纪念版主机不包含《塞尔达传说：时之笛》游戏软件。这款 Switch 2 游戏定于 11 月 5 日发售，需要单独购买。

这批硬件是系列 40 周年企划的一部分。任天堂还安排了 2027 年发售的幼年林克、幼年塞尔达 amiibo，以及以系列为主题的音乐会和博物馆内容。
title_en: Nintendo Releases 40th Anniversary Legend of Zelda Edition Switch 2
content_en:
Nintendo has officially released the 40th Anniversary *The Legend of Zelda* Edition Switch 2, alongside a themed Pro Controller and carrying case. The console, Joy-Con 2 controllers, and dock feature custom series-inspired artwork, while the Pro Controller comes with a dedicated display stand.

Nintendo explicitly noted that the special-edition console does not include *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time*. The game is scheduled for release on November 5 and must be purchased separately.

This hardware drop is part of a broader 40th-anniversary celebration for the franchise. Nintendo's upcoming plans also include Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo figures slated for 2027, as well as series-themed concerts and museum exhibits.

title_zh: 吉考斯工业 ×《影之刃零》联名开售，把角色与兵器做成日常服饰
content_zh:
随着《影之刃零》解锁，吉考斯工业与游戏的联名系列于 10 月 29 日在线上发售，共推出 10 款单品，将主角、Boss、兵器和场景元素融入服饰与包袋。

系列中，「魂」短袖 T 恤用武侠电影的烟雾意象表现持剑主角；「绝影」T 恤把肩甲图案、刀割暗纹与做旧蜡染结合；「七星剑阵」长袖 T 恤则通过印花与刺绣呈现大师兄的剑阵和丝线。

秋冬款包括以「烈焰狮头」Boss 为主题的提花毛衣开衫，以及取材于「魂」与「左殇」关系的双面穿马甲，后者可在绗缝面与摇粒绒面之间切换。「武器匣」斜挎包则将兵器图案放入内衬，肩带点缀主角装备上的「魔家纹样」刺绣徽章。
title_en: Gstone Labs Launches Apparel Collection Inspired by 'Phantom Blade Zero'
content_en:
Gstone Labs officially launched its apparel collaboration with the upcoming martial arts action game *Phantom Blade Zero* on October 29. The 10-piece capsule collection translates core game elements—including main characters, iconic bosses, legendary weapons, and scenic backdrops—into wearable everyday fashion and accessories.

Highlights from the lineup include graphic T-shirts featuring the protagonist Soul, distressed batik-dyed tops, and embroidered pieces reflecting intricate sword formations. For the colder months, the collection offers a jacquard knit cardigan inspired by the "Flame Lion" boss and a reversible quilted-fleece vest showcasing key character dynamics. A themed crossbody bag completes the drop, featuring weapon artwork in the lining and character emblem embroidery on the strap.

title_zh: 继星巴克后，宜家餐厅也重申「消费入座」
content_zh:
继星巴克后，上海徐汇宜家餐厅也重申「消费入座」。据澎湃新闻 10 月 29 日发布的现场探访，餐厅入口提示座位仅供就餐顾客使用，并要求顾客不要长时间占座、自带食物或聚众打牌；记者探访时，有未消费的老人被拦在门外。

宜家官方客服回应，目前仅徐汇店执行，其他门店尚未跟进。门店工作人员称，每周二、周四会有较多老人聚集，有人自带水果、喝酒或打牌，垃圾清理也增加了负担。受访老人则表示，并非所有人都来相亲，有人只是独自在家感到寂寞，也有老人支持消费后入座。

徐汇宜家的老年社交聚会由来已久。门店在 2016 年就曾因长时间占座和自带饮食等问题，宣布「先购餐，后入座」。星巴克已于 10 月 22 日在全国门店实行「消费入座」，并承诺优先帮助孕妇、行动不便者等特殊群体。
title_en: Shanghai IKEA Store Reenforces 'Purchase Required' Seating Policy
content_en:
Following a similar move by Starbucks, the IKEA restaurant in Shanghai’s Xuhui district has reinstated its "purchase required to sit" policy. Signs at the entrance now explicitly reserve seating for paying dining customers, asking patrons not to occupy tables for extended periods, bring outside food, or gather for card games.

IKEA customer service confirmed that the rule is currently exclusive to the Xuhui location, which has long served as a popular gathering spot for local seniors. Store staff noted that large groups frequently meet on Tuesdays and Thursdays, bringing outside food and drinks, which has increased cleaning and operational burdens on the restaurant.

This is not the first time the location has taken action; the Xuhui store previously introduced a "purchase before seating" rule in 2016 due to similar overcrowding issues. Meanwhile, Starbucks launched a nationwide policy requiring purchases for seating on October 22, while continuing to offer priority assistance to pregnant women and visitors with mobility challenges.

title_zh: 《危笑 3》换导演，《养鬼吃人》导演大卫·布鲁克纳接手
content_zh:
据 Variety 独家报道，派拉蒙已为《危笑 3》聘请新主创：大卫·布鲁克纳执导，尼克·安托斯卡编剧。前两部的编剧兼导演帕克·芬恩将转任制片人，第三部的故事框架仍由他提出。

布鲁克纳曾执导 2022 年版《养鬼吃人》，以及《夜间小屋》和《黑森灵》。安托斯卡则参与创作了《恶行》，并担任《鹿角》的编剧。

《危笑》前两部分别于 2022 年和 2024 年上映，故事从一名被诡异笑容纠缠的心理治疗师，转向遭遇同一超自然实体的流行歌手。芬恩目前还在为派拉蒙执导《着魔》翻拍版，主演为卡勒姆·特纳和玛格丽特·库里。
title_en: 'Smile 3' Taps 'Hellraiser' Director David Bruckner for Next Installment
content_en:
Paramount Pictures has hired David Bruckner (*Hellraiser*, *The Night House*) to direct *Smile 3*, according to an exclusive report from *Variety*. Nick Antosca (*The Act*, *Antlers*) is set to write the screenplay, while franchise creator Parker Finn will step into a producer role while supplying the story concept.

The hit horror franchise launched in 2022 and expanded with a sequel in 2024, following a sinister supernatural entity that torments victims with unsettling grins. The narrative evolved from a traumatized therapist in the original film to an international pop star in the follow-up.

Finn's transition to producing *Smile 3* allows him to focus on directing Paramount’s upcoming remake of *Possession*, starring Callum Turner and Margaret Qualley.

title_zh: 法伦与杰米·李·柯蒂斯恶搞 Theranos 创始人纪录片
content_zh:
《吉米今夜秀》在美国当地时间 10 月 28 日播出的开场短片中，主持人吉米·法伦与杰米·李·柯蒂斯模仿纪录片《You Can See Everything》里的内森·菲尔德和伊丽莎白·霍姆斯，重演了一场互相试探的访谈。

法伦模仿菲尔德的语气，反复追问嘉宾是否真心想来上节目；柯蒂斯戴上金色假发、压低嗓音扮演霍姆斯，强调自己是在与主持人真诚交流。等法伦离开，她立即换了态度，成为整段短片的笑点。

原纪录片由菲尔德与兰斯·奥本海姆联合执导，历时三年多秘密拍摄，记录 Theranos 创始人霍姆斯因欺诈投资者开始服刑前一个月的生活，已于 10 月 16 日在美国上映。柯蒂斯此次登上节目，是为她参与联合创作并客串的 NBC 新喜剧《Newlyweds》宣传。
title_en: Jimmy Fallon and Jamie Lee Curtis Parody Elizabeth Holmes Documentary on 'The Tonight Show'
content_en:
On the October 28 episode of *The Tonight Show*, host Jimmy Fallon and actress Jamie Lee Curtis opened the broadcast with a satire of the recent Theranos documentary *You Can See Everything*. The sketch spoofed a tense, awkward interview between filmmaker Nathan Fielder and disgraced Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes.

Fallon adopted Fielder's signature deadpan style, probing whether Curtis genuinely wanted to appear on the show. Wearing a blonde wig and putting on Holmes's infamous deep voice, Curtis repeatedly insisted on her authenticity—only to instantly drop the facade the moment Fallon left the set.

The real documentary, co-directed by Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, was secretly filmed over three years and captures Holmes's final month before serving her prison sentence for investor fraud. Curtis made the talk show appearance to promote her new NBC comedy series, *Newlyweds*, which she co-created and guest-stars in.

title_zh: 索尼取得《缄默祸运》电影改编权，库萨马执导
content_zh:
据 Deadline 报道，索尼影业取得心理恐怖游戏《缄默祸运》（Mouthwashing）的电影改编权，由《詹妮弗的肉体》《致命邀请》导演卡瑞恩·库萨马执导，马特·曼弗雷迪与菲尔·海负责剧本。

《黑色电话》导演斯科特·德瑞克森与 C. Robert Cargill、Vince Cheng 将通过 Crooked Highway 参与制片，该公司与索尼旗下 Screen Gems 有合作协议。

原作由瑞典独立工作室 Wrong Organ 开发、Critical Reflex 发行，于 2024 年推出，围绕困在货运飞船 Tulpar 上的五名船员展开，以非线性叙事呈现物资短缺、隔离和猜疑下的人物关系。库萨马与两位编剧此前曾合作《致命邀请》和《无间炼狱》。
title_en: Sony Pictures Nabs Film Adaptation Rights for Horror Hit 'Mouthwashing'
content_en:
Sony Pictures has secured the film rights to the acclaimed psychological horror video game *Mouthwashing*, according to *Deadline*. Director Karyn Kusama (*Jennifer's Body*, *The Invitation*) is set to helm the feature, with frequent collaborators Matt Manfredi and Phil Hay penning the screenplay.

The project will be produced by Scott Derrickson (*The Black Phone*), C. Robert Cargill, and Vince Cheng via their production company Crooked Highway, which maintains a partnership deal with Sony's Screen Gems.

Developed by Swedish indie studio Wrong Organ and published by Critical Reflex in 2024, the game centers on five crew members trapped aboard the stranded freighter *Tulpar*. Told through a non-linear narrative, it explores paranoia, isolation, and psychological collapse as resources run out.
